messages:
mara: Quick FYI 19: a support case shows users copying the Go generator quickstart and using context.Background() which leads to streams that don't cancel. Repro attached.

ivan: Oof. Quick fix for docs: show using r.Context() or a derived timeout and defer Close() immediately. Minimal snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
gen := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer gen.Close()
for gen.Next() { /* handle tokens */ }
```

lee: Also found the retry/backoff used time.Sleep; switched to time.NewTimer + select on timer.C and ctx.Done() so retries abort on cancel. Added a small test that cancels ctx and asserts no lingering goroutines.

mara: Perfect. Action items: docs PR to swap snippet + short sidebar "prefer request context, not Background()"; merge retry change; add integration leak test to CI.
